captures.excerpt_edited: inline <style data-emotion> blocks replaced by a comment
captures.note: One result card. Title (a[href^="/job/"]) and company (span[data-testid="companyName"]) both parse today; the page has 20 such cards and the adapter found 20 jobs from it. What it does NOT have is any description - there is no snippet element on the card and no descriptive text outside the requirement and benefit chips - which is why every stored simplyhired row has description_text NULL. Verbatim apart from the inline emotion <style> blocks, which were replaced by a comment: they are two thirds of the card's bytes and no parser reads them.
